professionalSummary.text: Execution system engineer with four years of experience across two electronics assembly plants, building changes per process engineers' specifications under plant software standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Execution system engineer at an electronics manufacturer for four years across two assembly plants, building the changes the process engineers specified under the plant software standard.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted 61 line sessions teaching supervisors each change during running shifts, with all sessions documented by supervisor-signed training records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Taught the supervisors each change on the line during a running shift under the line training standard; sixty-one line sessions across the two plants, every one with a supervisor-signed training record.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran all changes on pilot line first with pilot records filed and countersigned by process engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Every change ran on the pilot line first, with the pilot record filed against the change and countersigned by the process engineer.

experienceHighlights.text: Obtained execution system lead's go-ahead for all releases, with records documenting checks performed.
experienceHighlights.witness: The execution system lead gave the go-ahead for every release, recorded on the change alongside the checks that were mine.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented what each change leaves alone and hand-over conditions in every change record.
experienceHighlights.witness: A note of what the change leaves alone and what the next engineer needs to know sits at the end of every change record.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two change records with pilot records, lead's go-ahead, notes, and three supervisor-signed training records as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two change records with pilot records, the lead's go-ahead and the notes, and three supervisor-signed training records, with the change system references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Process engineering collaboration, pilot line testing, supervisor training, release management, documentation.
skills.witness: All experience points are documented in the CV.
